bounds.domain: Two providers share an account id. Two one-shot callers capture an existing generation and complete through a refresh or identity metadata write. Two initial records and one explicit save bound fresh generations. Credentials and optional identity tokens use values1..4. Labels use values1..2. Other identity metadata fields stay constant.
bounds.assumptions: Each storage call is atomic under the existing lock. Records start in canonical encrypted storage and use collision-free generation UUIDs in a valid private root. Legacy upgrade, cryptography, path admission, storage failure, process death, reset and deletion transactions require separate models.
bounds.progress: An admitted caller settles under weak fairness of its completion action. Any provider or caller work needed to reach the storage commit must eventually finish. The storage action has no cancellation input.

assumptions: Weak fairness of complete(reader) permits either refresh or conditional metadata for each pending receipt holder. Each holder starts and settles at most once.
Remote work and the storage lock eventually allow a pending call to return. Permanent service outage and real scheduler fairness are outside this finite instance.
